name: Ephemeral stories media pipeline / Define the success contract

intent.outcome: Design ephemeral photo and video stories that replicate to friends and expire in 24 hours.
intent.users: Callers, state owners and operators named by the problem.
intent.constraints: Make ordering, durability, capacity and retry assumptions explicit. Six simulated seconds stand in for the product lifetime. Models metadata visibility and view state; processing is a service-time model, not codecs, physical media erasure or a production privacy graph.
intent.success: An observable request path, bounded waiting, visible failures and a justified recovery policy.

concepts.label: Users and requests
concepts.responsibility: Who issues requests, and which identities or deadlines travel with them?
